description: Pak Agro Packaging Limited manufactures net bags and green shade nets for greenhouses and provides services for their manufacture, and describes itself as the first company to supply agricultural textiles to the local market when operations began in May 2001. Incorporated in February 1989 as Kohsar Tyres (Private) Limited, it was renamed Mian & Khan Industries in 1999 and Pak Agro Packaging in 2000, and became a public limited company in 2022; it is listed on the GEM board of the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: Office No. 302, 3rd Floor, Green Trust Tower, Jinnah Avenue, Blue Area, Islamabad, Pakistan
